mentions.name: 320x240 pixel art game maker
mentions.description: A game maker for 2D pixel art games at 320x240 resolution, similar to the meta-pico8 project, with working code-sharing and collaboration features. Work stalled after the author got stuck on fonts and realized the project had no barrier to entry, since a web app could be easily cloned.
mentions.problem: Development stalled on font support, compounded by the realization that the web-based project has no barrier to entry and could be very easily cloned, plus hesitation about targeting a fast-moving browser platform.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Interesting, I have been working on a similar project, albeit 320x240.

I also got some code-share and collaboration features working, but got a bit stuck on fonts.
